description: This file implements an HTTP server for the Ginkgo testing framework, specifically for internal parallel support. It manages communication endpoints, handles test reporting, synchronization, and streaming test output for parallel test execution.

classes.name: httpServer
classes.description: Represents an internal HTTP server for Ginkgo's parallel test reporting and synchronization.

methods.name: newHttpServer
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new httpServer instance with an automatically selected port.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Starts the HTTP server and sets up all streaming and synchronization endpoints.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Stops the HTTP server by closing its listener.

methods.name: Address
methods.description: Returns the server's accessible address URL.

methods.name: GetSuiteDone
methods.description: Returns a channel signaling when the test suite is done.

methods.name: GetOutputDestination
methods.description: Returns the current output destination writer.

methods.name: SetOutputDestination
methods.description: Sets the output destination writer.

methods.name: RegisterAlive
methods.description: Registers a function to check if a node is alive.

methods.name: decode
methods.description: Decodes JSON request body into an object, handling errors.

methods.name: handleError
methods.description: Handles errors by writing appropriate HTTP status codes.

methods.name: specSuiteWillBegin
methods.description: Handles the start of a test suite.

methods.name: didRun
methods.description: Handles the completion of a test.

methods.name: specSuiteDidEnd
methods.description: Handles the end of a test suite.

methods.name: emitOutput
methods.description: Handles output emission from tests.

methods.name: emitProgressReport
methods.description: Handles progress report updates.

methods.name: handleReportBeforeSuiteCompleted
methods.description: Handles report indicating a suite has completed.

methods.name: handleReportBeforeSuiteState
methods.description: Handles report of suite state before completion.

methods.name: handleBeforeSuiteCompleted
methods.description: Handles notification that a suite has completed.

methods.name: handleBeforeSuiteState
methods.description: Handles report of suite state before completion.

methods.name: handleHaveNonprimaryProcsFinished
methods.description: Checks if non-primary processes have finished.

methods.name: handleAggregatedNonprimaryProcsReport
methods.description: Handles aggregated report of non-primary processes.

methods.name: handleCounter
methods.description: Handles counter requests for parallel index.

methods.name: handleUp
methods.description: Responds to 'up' health check endpoint.

methods.name: handleAbort
methods.description: Handles abort requests for the test run.
